from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0048.png"))

mask_table = (img[:, :, 0] > 100) & (img[:, :, 0] < 160) & (img[:, :, 1] > 40) & (img[:, :, 1] < 80) & (img[:, :, 2] < 40)

# Let us check columns around the legs
for col in [55, 230, 345]:
    leg_ys = np.where(mask_table[:, col])[0]
    if len(leg_ys) > 0:
        print(f"Col {col}: leg bottom y={leg_ys.max()}")
